# `last`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the last value of `expr` for a group of rows.
If `isIgnoreNull` is true, returns only non-null values

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
last(expr[, isIgnoreNull])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- last, example 1
> SELECT last(col) FROM VALUES (10), (5), (20) AS tab(col);
20
```

```sql
-- last, example 2
> SELECT last(col) FROM VALUES (10), (5), (NULL) AS tab(col);
NULL
```

```sql
-- last, example 3
> SELECT last(col, true) FROM VALUES (10), (5), (NULL) AS tab(col);
5
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
